text_block_list.name: Spe & Grass
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!! —Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha...!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――OOOAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! In first place is—
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold is so strong! She's not falling 
behind Special Week and the others at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"People were calling it a two-horse race, 
but you just can't count out Stay Gold!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...I can't help thinking about it after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
About what you were... really like deep 
down.
――Stego-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Spe. Good work out there—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Stego-san's running today was amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My heart is still pounding, and I start 
trembling just remembering it. That's just 
how breathtakingly powerful it was...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“More than that, though...! I felt this 
burning fire inside me, shouting 'I refuse 
to lose!'...!!”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run. ...It really 
drove the point home for me all over 
again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"For us right now, you are... a formidable 
rival we must overcome."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Haha. Well, how should I put it――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad. Hearing that from all of 
you."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together again sometime! When we 
do, I promise I'll show you an even more 
amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Thanks, you two. Spe. Grass.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Telling me that I truly belong right 
here...)

"And so, Stay Gold's Takarazuka Kinen came 
to an end—"
――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know how things were for the 
other me, but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, I felt thoroughly 
refreshed after that last race."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
After all, I went toe-to-toe with girls 
whose overwhelming strength is etched into 
my very soul.
choice_data_list:
You're definitely closer to taking center 
stage of this era.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I can definitely... feel it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...So this was my pride, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what will happen at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)—

Autumn's presence is still far off. Yet 
her heart, and her eyes, gaze far into the 
distance—

Waiting for its arrival. ...For the yet 
unseen "Tenno Sho (Autumn)".
